chat.author: Dieter Sibold
chat.text: That is the link to the minutes. https://notes.ietf.org/notes-ietf-interim-2026-ntp-05-ntp?edit

chat.author: Danny Mayer
chat.text: It sound a bit too vague to implement

chat.author: Ruben Nijveld
chat.text: You could also consider the orbiter a new root, in which case the root delay precision is not relevant anymore?

chat.author: Marc Blanchet
chat.text: @Miroslav: I just verified with my colleague who did most of the tests, and yes, for some implementations, he had to change the config or value in code to handle the longer rtt. Not a protocol issue, but implementation config.

chat.author: Ruben Nijveld
chat.text: @Marc: I think this is specifically about the root_delay field in NTP packets, as soon as you go beyond the orbiter your root delay (given that the root is somewhere on earth), would be massive, exceeding the capacity of that field in the NTP packet format. But this might be something that is better handled via the mailing list!
